1	# triage.py
2	
3	A module that sorts a customer support ticket for an online store into one category by asking a language
4	model. It is one component of a larger program, so it takes the API client as an argument and never creates
5	one. Use only the Python standard library, and don't import the `anthropic` package.
6	
7	## Constants
8	
9	- `CATEGORIES` is the tuple `("billing", "login", "shipping", "other")`.
10	- `MODEL` is `"claude-sonnet-5-5"`.
11	- `SYSTEM_PROMPT` is exactly
12	  `"You sort customer support tickets for an online store. Reply with exactly one word from this list: billing, login, shipping, other."`
13	
14	## answer_text(reply)
15	
16	`reply` has a `content` list of blocks, and each block has a `type`. Return the `text` of every block whose
17	type is `"text"`, joined with nothing between them. Ignore every other block: a reply can carry `thinking`
18	blocks, whose text is empty.
19	
20	## parse_category(text)
21	
22	Strip surrounding whitespace and lowercase the result. Return it if it is one of `CATEGORIES`, and otherwise
23	return the string `"unrecognized"`. Do no other cleanup, so `"Billing."` is `"unrecognized"`.
24	
25	## normalize_label(raw)
26	
27	A tolerant alternative to `parse_category`, for a caller that wants every reply forced into a category.
28	Lowercase `raw`, then remove every whitespace and punctuation character (Python's `string.whitespace` and
29	`string.punctuation`) from both ends. Return the result if it is one of `CATEGORIES`, and otherwise return
30	`"other"`.
31	
32	## triage(client, ticket, model=MODEL)
33	
34	Raise `ValueError` if `ticket` is empty or only whitespace, without calling the client. Otherwise call
35	`client.messages.create` with exactly these keyword arguments and no others:
36	
37	    model=model, max_tokens=1024, system=SYSTEM_PROMPT,
38	    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": ticket}]
39	
40	Pass the ticket unchanged. Return `parse_category(answer_text(reply))`.
